item.title: Overview of Malachi - Returning to the God Who Loves Us 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story: Living With Unfulfilled Expectations # Have you ever looked forward to something for so long that you were certain it would change everything? Perhaps it was graduation. Perhaps it was marriage. Perhaps it was a new ministry, a new job, a new home, or a long-awaited answer to prayer. For months or even years, you carried a picture in your mind of what life would be like when that moment finally arrived. You imagined the joy, the satisfaction, and the sense of fulfillment. Then the day came. At first, everything seemed wonderful. The dream became reality.

item.title: Overview of Joel - Hearing God in Seasons of Loss
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # She had never read the book of Joel. In fact, she had never even paused long enough to wonder what might be inside those three short chapters tucked quietly among the Minor Prophets. Her Bible reading habits had always gravitated toward the familiar, the comforting cadence of the Psalms, the narrative sweep of Genesis, the clarity of the Gospels. Joel, by contrast, felt like a sealed room in an old house: present, but unexplored; small, but somehow intimidating.
